parts.name: dog
sources: Quaternius, Ultimate Animated Animal Pack: ShibaInu.gltf (from https://pixeltriks.com). https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html CC0 1.0 (public domain): https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
A street dog of Việt Nam (chó cỏ): a medium dog of mixed breed with a short tan coat, about 50 cm at the shoulder, ears up, a tail that curls up.
The size is a guess from photos and from the medium breeds of dogs (about 15 kg): no measurements. The template is a Shiba Inu, a dog of the same shape (ears up, a curled tail).
